QuestInfo.name: Powerless
QuestInfo.0: You arrived at Momijigaoka, the new base. The red maple leaves here really are quite distinctive! Someone around here must know what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Motonari and his three sons arrived on this world before anyone else and built Momijigaoka base. He showed you that you can't use your usual magic here.
QuestInfo.2: Motonari explains that you feel weak because the laws of physics in this world differ from those in Sokoku. He offers to help.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,242 Can proceed to the Adaptation 1 quest
